fidelityReview.notes: Read the current architect RSHP project and two-page job-sheet PDF and current WTC owner page. Actually inspected both cached PDF page pixels and the enlarged typical floor plan, including completed K-braced profile and eight corner-office plan. Original295672triangle/29241552byte master reproduces sha256:c852966c1bade563c67510b302788dd4fedaf1e892a35a08d8b7c1db12411e5e. Published owner1079ft height and architect terrace/facade/floor/lobby dimensions are retained; architect rounded330m is not presented as agreement with exact328.8792m. The unchanged original build3Wtc recipe reproduces295672triangles/29241552bytes exactly. Reviewed source preserves the independent skew podium, three connected cruciform planes with unequal northern/southern terraces, four projecting stainless K-frame zones at original cadence, full-height central corner columns, tower/podium facade datums, closed mechanical crown, all three terrace decks with glass guards, planted gardens, reconstructed benches, GreenwichStreet cable-net lobby and three revolving door enclosures. Continuous glass walls, flat mullion/transom/spandrel strips and flat crown-louver strips replace repeated pane cells and section shells. Tiny cover-joint seams are omitted. Shared stainless and granite graphs serve two reusable textures; vegetation shares granite with green vertex tint as a deliberate coarse surface approximation, and tinted stainless approximates painted roof/bench finishes. Glass/recess use one opaque vision-glass palette; door glass retains a separate translucent palette, four near draw groups total. Skyline retains stepped envelope, flattened two-sided K-brace ribbons at original cadence, roof decks and guards, sparse40-floor facade bands and unframed mechanical recesses; it omits facade mullions, entrance hardware, planters/benches and roof equipment. District restores four-floor bands, coarse vertical mullions, two-sided flattened braces and three low-sided door casings, omitting K connection nodes, cable-net tubes, garden furniture and rooftop equipment. Street restores all facade floor datums, sparse glass guard posts, brace plates, coarse vegetation and rooftop boxes with20-sided door glass; near adds published5ft/10ft module framing, dense louvers/guards/plants, cable-net nodes,36-sided doors and rooftop grilles. Upper part regularization, exact facade phase, intermediate mechanical/lobby panel datums, K-brace spacing/section, roof service equipment, terrace furnishings and entry hardware remain photo reconstructions. Architect rounded330m height differs from selected owner1079ft/328.8792m. Physical-device/dense-city timings and surveyed curb/entry fit remain unmeasured. The merged branch changed model geometry since the previous approval. The current source generator/import reproduced the currently declared master bytes, all six GLBs were validated, and fresh portable, shared-material/geographic-flat and Earth-context images were inspected. Existing focused tests verify the current distinguishing geometry, signed footprint and browser budgets. The current review supersedes the previous geometry/hash approval; it does not claim unchanged GLBs relative to that older approval. Existing reference/placement scope remains explicit.
